outcomes.name: Stakeholders have been identified, analysed and prioritised
outcomes.description: Stakeholders are understood, segmented and prioritised according to their influence, impact, needs and level of involvement.

outcomes.name: Stakeholders are actively engaged and informed
outcomes.description: Stakeholders receive appropriate communication, have opportunities to participate, and can provide feedback throughout the change lifecycle.

outcomes.name: Engagement and communications support successful adoption
outcomes.description: Stakeholder insight, engagement and communications are actively managed, measured and adapted to support sustained change adoption.

actions.action: Identify stakeholders likely to influence, support, be affected by or be impacted by the change.
Analyse stakeholder influence, interest, commitment, capability and potential impact.
Segment stakeholders into logical groups with similar characteristics and needs.
Conduct initial engagement activities to understand stakeholder perspectives and expectations.
Identify stakeholder concerns, opportunities, preferences and communication needs.
Develop an initial stakeholder engagement and communications approach.
Define communication objectives, engagement objectives and desired outcomes.
Develop key messages that explain the change consistently and appropriately.
Identify dependencies between engagement activity and other change workstreams.
Agree sponsorship and accountability for stakeholder engagement and communications activities.
Implement targeted communications tailored to different stakeholder groups.
Implement stakeholder engagement activities using appropriate channels and methods.
Provide opportunities for stakeholders to participate, contribute and influence aspects of the change.
Ensure communications remain timely, relevant and aligned to programme developments.
Establish mechanisms for gathering stakeholder feedback and engagement insight.
Review stakeholder engagement progress through governance mechanisms.
Define measures to assess communication reach, engagement levels and stakeholder understanding.
Coordinate engagement activities with communications, learning, readiness and adoption activities.
Develop a detailed stakeholder engagement and communications plan.
Equip sponsors, managers and change agents with communication materials and engagement guidance.
Monitor stakeholder engagement levels, sentiment and communication effectiveness.
Respond to stakeholder concerns, questions and emerging issues in a timely manner.
Adapt communications using stakeholder feedback and implementation experience.
Use stakeholder representatives, champions and networks to strengthen engagement activity.
Assess stakeholder understanding, involvement and support for the change.
Review engagement effectiveness and communication performance through governance forums.
Refine engagement and communication approaches using evidence, insight and lessons learned.
Align engagement activities with implementation, adoption and readiness priorities.
Use engagement and communication metrics to inform planning and decision-making.
Promote key successes, achievements and progress through communication channels.
Maintain continuous engagement with stakeholders beyond implementation.
Ensure communications continue to support adoption, optimisation and continuous improvement.
Measure long-term stakeholder confidence, advocacy and engagement.
Use organisational learning to continuously improve engagement and communication approaches.
Embed effective engagement and communication practices into organisational change standards.
